en.name: Beretta ARX 160 Platform
en.description: The Beretta ARX160 is an Italian modular assault rifle manufactured by Beretta. Developed for the Italian Armed Forces as part of the 'Future Soldier' program.

en.name: Black ARX 160 Stock
en.description: This is a heavily modified version of the Magpul UBR stock. It is stuck in its most open position. Has an upholstered comb for a more comfortable cheek-weld.

en.name: RexTac Black Front Sight
en.description: A heavily modified Magpul MBUS Front Sight with proprietary fiber optic inlays.

en.description: The Beretta ARX160 is an Italian modular assault rifle manufactured by Beretta. Developed for the Italian Armed Forces as part of the 'Future Soldier' program. This one in is fabricated in a custom white colour so as to not be lost in the blackness of space. This version is for literal Astronauts.

en.name: 5.56x45 Lancer L5-AWM 30-round Magazine (WHT)
en.description: Lancer set out to design a better 5.56 magazine; one with the reliability of steel and the durability and weight of polymer. The L5 Advanced Warfighter Magazine (AWM) is that magazine. This one in is fabricated in a custom white colour so as to not be lost in the blackness of space. This version is for literal Astronauts.
